title: Seaport
summary: SE'APORT, noun [sea and port.] 1. A harbor near the sea, formed by an arm of the sea or by a bay. 2. A city or town situated on a harbor, on or near the sea. We call a town a seaport, instead fo a sea

inlines.v: SE'APORT, noun [sea and port.] 1. A harbor near the sea, formed by an arm of the sea or by a bay. 2. A city or town situated on a harbor, on or near the sea. We call a town a seaport, instead fo a seaport town.
